coverage_model: implemented=complete for the stated claim_scope; partial=bounded executable slice with unresolved requirements; context_required=no safe automatic verdict without stated missing context; not_implemented=no executable check

unresolved_requirements: Complete technical-term classification and contextual dictionary-use decisions.
rules.claim_scope: Known dictionary approval status, ambiguity blockers, and unknown-term classification only.

unresolved_requirements: General sentence parsing and part-of-speech resolution outside bounded frames.
rules.claim_scope: Approved dictionary part-of-speech misuse in bounded noun/verb frames recognized by the syntax substrate.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic approved-sense disambiguation.
rules.claim_scope: Occurrences with explicit project dictionary-meaning evidence only.

unresolved_requirements: Executable recognition of verb/adjective forms that are outside the dictionary-approved form inventory, with grammatical-role disambiguation.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic Rule 1.4 verdict is currently implemented.

unresolved_requirements: Classification of a candidate word into an Issue 9 technical-noun category.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of technical-noun category eligibility.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic classification of unknown words as technical nouns or parts of technical nouns.
rules.claim_scope: Unknown prose terms are blocked pending project classification; the linter does not infer technical-noun status from prose.

unresolved_requirements: Technical-noun grammatical-role resolution outside the strong imperative frame.
rules.claim_scope: Governed technical-noun misuse in the strong imperative verb frame only.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic company, industry, or subject-field approval for technical nouns not supplied by governed project terminology.
rules.claim_scope: Deprecated governed project technical nouns are rejected; other approval authorities remain contextual.

unresolved_requirements: Judgment that a selected technical noun is short and easy for the intended reader to understand.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of technical-noun brevity and ease of understanding.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic international-versus-regional/slang/jargon classification.
rules.claim_scope: Occurrences with explicit project technical-noun-scope evidence only.

unresolved_requirements: Document-wide item identity and technical-noun consistency.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation that the same item keeps the same technical noun across the document.

unresolved_requirements: Classification of a candidate verb into an Issue 9 technical-verb category.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of technical-verb category eligibility.

unresolved_requirements: Technical-verb grammatical-role resolution outside the determiner-led frame.
rules.claim_scope: Governed technical-verb misuse in a determiner-led nominal frame only.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic spelling classification and official-directive recognition.
rules.claim_scope: Occurrences with explicit spelling evidence and official-technical-name exception only.

unresolved_requirements: Multi-word noun boundaries outside the uniquely resolved determiner-led Grammar v1 frame, including ambiguous or mixed part-of-speech noun heads.
rules.claim_scope: Uniquely resolved determiner-led multi-word nouns whose noun/adjective content after the determiner exceeds three words.

unresolved_requirements: Non-governed technical-noun identity and alias relationships, hyphen-generated clarification, aliases outside the bounded shorter-form slice, and document/format cases outside shared Entity/reference evidence.
rules.claim_scope: Approved governed technical nouns longer than three words whose explicit no-more-than-three-word shorter glossary alias appears before the first canonical full-form mention.

unresolved_requirements: Executable recognition that a verb form is outside the forms supplied for its dictionary verb entry.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic Rule 3.1 verdict is currently implemented.

unresolved_requirements: Allowed/prohibited verb-form and tense recognition outside the direct HAVE/HAS/HAD plus participle slice.
rules.claim_scope: Direct perfect-tense constructions are checked; the complete Issue 9 verb-form and tense inventory is not.

unresolved_requirements: Participle adjective-versus-verb/passive distinction.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic distinction between participle-as-adjective and passive/verb use.

unresolved_requirements: Complex auxiliary constructions outside the direct HAVE/HAS/HAD plus participle pattern and deeper ambiguity resolution.
rules.claim_scope: Direct HAVE/HAS/HAD plus an unambiguous approved past participle only.

unresolved_requirements: Technical-noun and technical-noun-modifier -ing roles outside resolved Grammar v1 evidence, including ambiguous role evidence.
rules.claim_scope: Resolved progressive -ing verb use from shared Grammar v1 evidence only.

unresolved_requirements: Descriptive passive actor-known/unknown semantics and passive-versus-adjectival ambiguity outside the resolved procedural passive frame.
rules.claim_scope: Resolved passive-verb participle in procedural mode only; descriptive passive and ambiguous participles are not automatically rejected.

unresolved_requirements: General action-word role resolution.
rules.claim_scope: Bounded action-word role and part-of-speech misuse only.

unresolved_requirements: Sentence clarity and structural simplicity beyond the bounded Issue 9 length limits.
rules.claim_scope: Procedural and descriptive overlength sentence units provide a bounded short-sentence check; general sentence clarity remains unresolved.

unresolved_requirements: Omitted-word detection and non-deterministic or context-sensitive contraction-like forms.
rules.claim_scope: Deterministic contraction forms only; omitted words are not inferred.

unresolved_requirements: Nested, mixed, wrapped, and sentence-versus-fragment list semantics.
rules.claim_scope: Simple same-indent vertical-list mechanics only.

unresolved_requirements: Related-topic identity and selection of an appropriate connecting word or phrase.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of sentence connection and discourse relationship.

unresolved_requirements: Noun/multi-word-noun identification plus contextual judgment of when an article or demonstrative adjective is applicable.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of required articles or demonstrative adjectives before nouns.

unresolved_requirements: Context-dependent one-word identities not supplied to the counter.
rules.claim_scope: Procedural 20-word limit using the current Issue 9 counting model.

unresolved_requirements: Instruction intent and action structures outside the resolved sentence-initial base-form plus coordinated base-verb frame, including implicit, nested, non-coordinated, simultaneous, and otherwise unresolved actions.
rules.claim_scope: Resolved multiple-action cardinality in procedural sentences recognized by shared Grammar v1 action structure only; simultaneous-action exceptions are not inferred.

unresolved_requirements: Imperative recognition outside the bounded source-backed base-form frame.
rules.claim_scope: Bounded sentence-initial approved base-form imperative structure only.

unresolved_requirements: Condition semantics beyond the leading IF/WHEN structural slice.
rules.claim_scope: Leading IF/WHEN condition position and comma structure only.

unresolved_requirements: Instruction semantics in notes outside sentence-initial source-backed imperative candidates.
rules.claim_scope: Sentence-initial imperative candidates in NOTE blocks only; note sentence length is governed separately by descriptive Rule 6.3.

unresolved_requirements: Gradual information sequencing and one-subject-per-sentence semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of gradual information flow or single-subject descriptive sentences.

unresolved_requirements: Identification and use of key words/key phrases that establish a logical text structure.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of key-word/key-phrase logical structure.

unresolved_requirements: Unannotated semantic one-word identities required by Rule 8.6.
rules.claim_scope: Descriptive 25-word limit using mechanical and explicit context count groups.

unresolved_requirements: Logical grouping of related information into paragraphs.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of logical information grouping into paragraphs.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic topic inference and topic-sentence progression.
rules.claim_scope: Multiple distinct topics only when project topic evidence is supplied.

unresolved_requirements: Paragraph identity in document formats that do not use blank-line prose boundaries.
rules.claim_scope: Sentence count in blank-line paragraphs with recognized simple-list exclusions.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic risk-level classification from prose, missing safety labels or symbols, and conflicting or insufficient project risk authority.
rules.claim_scope: Observed WARNING/CAUTION label versus one unambiguous supplied project safety level for the same validated safety block only.

unresolved_requirements: Complete safety command/condition semantics and multi-action analysis.
rules.claim_scope: WARNING/CAUTION opening and bounded imperative action structure only.

unresolved_requirements: Risk, consequence, explanation, and possible-result semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of safety-result explanation or consequence semantics.

unresolved_requirements: All other standard-English punctuation decisions.
rules.claim_scope: Semicolon prohibition, including semicolon-ended items in recognized simple vertical lists.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic semantic judgment of whether hyphenated words are directly related.
rules.claim_scope: Hyphen direct-relation judgment only when explicit project evidence is supplied.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic semantic classification of parenthetical use.
rules.claim_scope: Parenthesis-use category only when explicit project evidence is supplied.

unresolved_requirements: Complex or nested vertical-list boundary semantics.
rules.claim_scope: Colon/list boundary behavior in the current simple vertical-list word-count model.
Parenthetical text groups count as one word in the current text-level analyzer.

unresolved_requirements: Unannotated semantic titles, headings, placards, labels, abbreviations, and proper nouns.
rules.claim_scope: Mechanical one-word groups plus explicitly identified abbreviations, titles, headings, placards, labels, and proper nouns.
Hyphenated token groups count as one word in the current text-level analyzer.

unresolved_requirements: Judgment that word-for-word replacement is insufficient and selection of a meaning-preserving alternative sentence construction.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of when a different sentence construction is required.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic approved-meaning/context disambiguation for approved words.
rules.claim_scope: Explicit project evidence that an approved dictionary occurrence uses a non-approved meaning only.

unresolved_requirements: Phrasal-verb recognition requires identifying an approved verb plus preposition combination whose combined meaning differs from the approved meanings of its parts.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic Rule 9.3 verdict is currently implemented; unapproved multiword dictionary entries are not treated as phrasal-verb proof.

unresolved_requirements: Document-wide terminology and wording consistency for repeated work-step types and concepts.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of terminology or wording consistency across a document.
